title: lncRNA-discovery pipeline parameters
description: Disease-agnostic lncRNA discovery, curation, and differential expression pipeline

input_output.title: Input/Output
input_output.description: Input data paths and output directory

star_index.description: STAR index directory (optional, for StringTie2 guided mode)

publish_level.description: How much of the run tree is published: core = deliverables/ only; core_raw = deliverables/ + raw/ + run_info/; full = also heavy audit outputs (bam_validation logs)

export_xlsx.description: Also export optional xlsx copies of the per-contrast DE tables (non-blocking; the TSV remains the source of truth)

design_check.description: Per-contrast design rank-check behaviour: fail aborts on a rank-deficient design, warn records it

cis_normalize.description: Normalize cis associations (VST blind=FALSE + limma::removeBatchEffect keeping condition) before Spearman; false = previous log2(counts+1)

design_formula.description: R formula for DESeq2 design (e.g. '~ batch + condition')

covariates.description: Extra covariate columns from samplesheet to include in model

expression_recurrence_min_reps.description: Minimum biological replicates with expression support

tier1_classes.description: gffcompare class codes considered Tier 1 at the transcript level

tier1a_classes.description: Subset of tier1_classes assigned novel_type 1a; other tier1 classes (j/o) are 1b only when the parent gene is not protein_coding

tier1_parent_biotypes.description: Parent-gene biotype whitelist for j/o Tier 1b; other parents (pseudogenes, TEC, small-RNA hosts) go to Tier 2

tier1_allow_single_exon.description: When false (default), mono-exonic transcripts of any class are demoted to Tier 2 and marked single_exon_low_confidence. Categorical rule, no derived threshold.

annotated_lncrna_biotypes.description: gene_biotype values treated as annotated lncRNA in the gene catalog

lfc_threshold.description: Post-hoc LFC cutoff (|log2FoldChange| >= value) applied only to the `significant` flag on the shrunken log2FC; it is NOT passed to DESeq2 results() (that would change the null hypothesis and padj). Default is set by the researcher.

heterogeneity_analysis.description: Per-norm_group opt-in map for the expression-heterogeneity diagnostic (Carrasco-Leon et al. 2021). Groups not listed default to disabled, e.g. {"MNC": true, "NB4": false}.

heterogeneity_concordant_frac.description: Minimum fraction of case samples agreeing on direction (vs control) to call a gene 'altered'

heterogeneity_discordant_frac.description: Maximum fraction of case samples in the opposite direction still allowed for an 'altered' call

strandedness.title: Library Strandedness
strandedness.description: Single strandedness contract shared by Salmon, featureCounts and StringTie (see lib/Strandedness.groovy). reverse = fr-firststrand (dUTP), the usual RNA-seq case.

library_strandedness.description: Single source of truth. reverse -> ISR/-s 2/--rf; forward -> ISF/-s 1/--fr; unstranded -> IU/-s 0/(no flag).

salmon_libtype.description: OPTIONAL override of the Salmon -l value. If set it must match the libtype derived from library_strandedness or the pipeline fails.

featurecounts_strandness.description: OPTIONAL override of featureCounts -s. If set it must match the value derived from library_strandedness (0/1/2) or the pipeline fails.

strandedness_min_fidelity.description: Minimum E/(E+O) strandedness fidelity per sample before CHECK_STRANDEDNESS warns (observed 0.80-0.89 in the pilot cohort).

strandedness_guard_strict.description: When true, a sample below strandedness_min_fidelity becomes a hard failure instead of a warning.

salmon_min_compat_ratio.description: Hard floor for compatible_fragment_ratio; below it CHECK_SALMON_LIBTYPE fails (otherwise informational).

salmon_min_orientation_ratio.description: Hard floor for declared/(declared+opposite) in lib_format_counts.json (e.g. ISR/(ISR+ISF) >= 0.70).

f1_flags.title: F1 flags (metrics and derived thresholds)
f1_flags.description: Phase A mono-exonic flank and antisense-leakage flags. Thresholds are derived from controls at run time.

run_flank_check.description: Run the exploratory F1.3 mono-exonic flank coverage check. Off by default: it failed its pre-specified control separation and does not gate tier_final.

f1_flank_bp.description: Flank window (+/- bp) around mono-exonic candidates

f1_min_flank_len.description: Minimum unmasked flank length; shorter means the flank is NA

f1_min_reads.description: Minimum same-strand reads for a sample to contribute a metric

f1_min_controls.description: Minimum control-set size to trust a derived threshold

f1_neg_reject_min.description: Minimum neg_flank rejection rate at the derived flank threshold

f1_flank_percentile.description: Flank threshold percentile of pos_flank flank_ratio_median

f1_antisense_percentile.description: Antisense threshold percentile of null_antisense ratio_median

flank_ratio_threshold.description: Override for the derived flank threshold (takes priority when set)

antisense_ratio_threshold.description: Override for the derived antisense threshold (takes priority when set)

flank_ratio_default.description: Fallback flank threshold when controls are unreliable

antisense_ratio_default.description: Fallback antisense threshold when controls are unreliable

f1_antisense_pos_flag_max.description: Max fraction of pos_antisense flagged at the derived antisense threshold before it is reported as not specific (diagnostic only)

external_tools.title: External Tool Dependencies
external_tools.description: Paths to pre-built model files required by external tools

cpat_hexamer.description: CPAT hexamer frequency table. Auto-generated from GTF if not provided.

cpat_logit_model.description: CPAT logistic regression model. Auto-generated from GTF if not provided.

gencode_transcripts_fa.description: Reference transcriptome FASTA for Salmon index. Derived from GTF+genome via gffread if not provided.

catalog_identity.title: Stable Catalog Identity (novel lncRNA registry)
catalog_identity.description: Persistent two-level (gene+transcript) registry that assigns stable catalog IDs to novel lncRNAs across runs.

catalog_registry.description: Persistent TSV registry path OUTSIDE results/. Passed as a val so a missing file on the first run does not fail path resolution. null disables the feature.

catalog_registry_project.description: Provenance label (e.g. CRUK_DDX41_DHX34) recorded as first_seen_project for newly created registry entries.

catalog_registry_allow_cross_project.description: Allow extending a registry that carries a different catalog_registry_project label. Off by default: mixing projects into one registry is a provenance risk.

catalog_registry_min_reciprocal.description: Reciprocal overlap threshold used to match novel genes/transcripts against existing registry entries.

catalog_id_prefix.description: String prefix of the hierarchical catalog ID at gene level (e.g. LNC000001).

external_catalog_min_reciprocal.description: Reciprocal overlap threshold for the STRICT external-catalog hit call (known_catalog_hit).
